lead: Rahul Gandhi is a widely followed Indian politician, born on 19 June 1970 in New Delhi.
As of 2026, he is 56 years old, and his birth date places him under the Gemini sign.
He has held the office of Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha and Member of the 18th Lok Sabha and has been recognised with the CNN-News18 Indian of the Year.
Below you will find a verified overview of Rahul Gandhi: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

sections.heading: Rahul Gandhi — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Rahul Gandhi was born on 19 June 1970 in New Delhi, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name his father, Rajiv Gandhi and his mother, Sonia Gandhi. He is a sibling of Priyanka Vadra.
His listed education includes Rollins College, Trinity College, Harvard University and University of Delhi.

sections.heading: Rahul Gandhi — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists politician as his main occupation.

He has held the following offices: Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha (2024–present), Member of the 18th Lok Sabha (2024–present), Member of the 17th Lok Sabha (2019–2023), Member of the 16th Lok Sabha, Member of the 15th Lok Sabha and Member of the 14th Lok Sabha (2004–present).
